# Typed Events Requirements Checklist: Typed events, `@emits` and the domain vocabulary

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements of this feature: are the modes, the five kinds of method and the event contract written completely, clearly and without conflict, before tasks are generated
**Created**: 2026-11-02
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Is every input a logging tool can receive listed with its outcome: an event, `kwargs`, no variables, both together, a class, another object? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, §FR-008, §FR-010]
- [x] CHK002 Is it specified whether an instance of `BaseEvent` itself, with no subclass, may be emitted? [Gap, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK003 Is it specified what happens when `@emits` is applied twice to one method? [Gap, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK004 Are the valid forms of `events` fully specified, including a non-tuple value and a repeated class? [Completeness, Spec §FR-018]
- [x] CHK005 Is it specified which public module an author imports `BaseEvent` and `@emits` from? [Gap]
- [x] CHK006 Does the spec state what a runtime refusal must name, as FR-019 does for the build failure? [Gap, Spec §FR-013, §FR-019]
- [x] CHK007 Are the seven places in the constitution identifiable from the spec alone, or only through #333? [Completeness, Spec §FR-026]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK008 Is "a line with no event" defined so that a template with no variables is clearly included? [Clarity, Spec §Key Entities]
- [x] CHK009 Is "refused" given one meaning across class definition, building an event, the build and runtime? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, §FR-003, §FR-019, §FR-020]
- [x] CHK010 Is "reads `var` by key" defined precisely enough to tell which logger operations are promised on both forms? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK011 Is "guaranteed structure" of an event replaced by something a reviewer can check? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK012 Is "the fact's own fields" unambiguous for a field inherited from an intermediate event class? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK013 Is "operation code" defined so that a helper receiving `box` from a method is clearly inside the rule? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016]
- [x] CHK014 Is "the method's own domain" unambiguous for an action that inherits a method from a parent action in another domain? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-021]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK015 Does every cell of the table of modes agree with FR-013, FR-017 and FR-020? [Consistency, Spec §Key Entities]
- [x] CHK016 Do the table of modes and User Story 1 agree that a method with no switch may emit an event? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 1]
- [x] CHK017 Do the five kinds of method appear with the same names and the same outcomes in FR-012, FR-015, User Story 2 and SC-002? [Consistency]
- [x] CHK018 Are the spec, #333 and #95 consistent on every rule of the event, the call and the modes? [Consistency]
- [x] CHK019 Do FR-009 and SC-004 agree on what may change in the logging package? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, §SC-004]
- [x] CHK020 Do the plan's phases cover every requirement, with each requirement in the earliest phase that can satisfy it? [Consistency, Traceability]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK021 Can SC-001 be measured by something other than a person's judgement? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK022 Is "the same refusal" in SC-006 defined: the same error, or the same message too? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]
- [x] CHK023 Does each FR have at least one acceptance scenario or edge case that exercises it? [Traceability]
- [x] CHK024 Is the adversarial requirement traceable to a named test for each rule? [Traceability, Spec §FR-031]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK025 Are requirements given for each of the five kinds of method in each of the three modes, including compensators and error handlers in mode 3? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 2, §User Story 3]
- [x] CHK026 Are requirements given for both machines, async and sync? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-022]
- [x] CHK027 Is behaviour under a mocked nested action in `TestBench` specified? [Coverage, Gap]
- [x] CHK028 Is the path of a refusal specified when several rules break at once, or does the order not matter? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-020]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK029 Is the order specified between a refusal and a template error in the same call? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK030 Is the build check defined for an action that inherits a method with `@emits` into another domain? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-019]
- [x] CHK031 Is it specified how a child domain's own `events` relate to its parent's: a narrower list, a wider one, or anything? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-018]
- [x] CHK032 Are event fields holding nested schemas addressed for templates and dumps? [Edge Case, Coverage]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK033 Is it stated that a sensitive value in a plain field reaches a logger unmasked, and is that intended? [Security, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK034 Is the cost of a run with no switch on stated as a requirement, or deliberately left out? [Gap, Performance]
- [x] CHK035 Is support for Python 3.14 stated alongside 3.12 for the new class-definition checks? [Gap, Assumption]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK036 Is what #334 needs from this work (how a declaration is read) written anywhere a reader of the spec would find it? [Dependency, Spec §FR-024]
- [x] CHK037 Is the assumption that the chapter's rollback example "reads true either way" something a reviewer can verify? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK038 Does "every case this work introduces" have an enumerable list, so the rule of Principle VI can be checked? [Measurability, Spec §User Story 5, §FR-027]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
